description: Search long-term and holiday rentals in North Goa, India (Morjim, Arambol, Mandrem, Ashwem, Siolim...). Pass the user's request as plain text in `query`, in any language (e.g. '2BHK in Mandrem under 60k for January, quiet, with AC'), and/or explicit filters; explicit filters win. Returns up to 10 places, newest first, with monthly and nightly prices in Indian rupees, distance to the beach, amenities, photos, the date the owner last confirmed availability and a Telegram link where the user contacts the realtor. With `stay_month`, only that month's explicit tariff is used for the displayed price, budget filter and price sort; no other-season or unlabelled legacy rate is substituted. Unknown prices are excluded when a budget is set, and shown with `price_status: unknown` and `price_month_inr: null` otherwise. Read-only: it never books or contacts anyone.

has_video.description: Only places with a video tour.

location.description: Area, e.g. 'Mandrem'. Comma-separated for several. See get_locations.

max_distance_m.description: Max distance to the beach, metres.

query.description: The user's request in plain language, any language.

quiet.description: Only quiet places, away from roads and bars.

sort.description: Order: newest first, cheapest monthly rent first, or closest to the beach first.

stay_month.description: Month of arrival, 1-12 (prices depend on season).

type.description: 1RK, Studio, 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, House, Bungalow, Room, Villa, Hotel. Comma-separated for several.

name: search_properties

applied_filters.description: Filters actually used (parsed from query + explicit).

count.description: How many places match in total.

error.description: Set instead of the result when the call failed.

booked_from.description: ISO date the place is booked from, if known.

description.description: Realtor's description in Russian; contacts removed.

description_en.description: The description in English; null if not translated yet.

distance_to_sea.description: Distance to the beach as the realtor gave it, in English, e.g. '300 m', '1-2 km', '5 min by bike'.

distance_to_sea_m.description: Distance to the beach in metres (lower bound of a range); null if given as travel time or unknown.

free_from.description: ISO date the place is free from. Set = rented right now, frees up on this date (shown up to a month ahead, listed after places free today) — never call it available now.

booked.description: Dates this room is taken, e.g. 13.02–13.03.

price_month_inr.description: Set instead of price_night_inr when rooms are rented by the month.

id.description: Property id; pass it to get_property.

listed_on.description: ISO date of publication (not a confirmation).

owner_confirmed_on.description: ISO date the OWNER last confirmed it is available. null = not confirmed; never promise availability.

price_context.description: Copy these values into get_property or compare_properties to preserve the search price context.

price_month_inr.description: Monthly rent in INR. Null when the requested period has no matching tariff.

price_night_inr.description: Price per night, INR (short stays and hotels).

price_note.description: Set when the requested month has no listed price: say so, the realtor will quote it.

price_note_ru.description: The same in Russian, e.g. 'Цена на декабрь не указана'.

price_peak_inr.description: Monthly rent at peak (Christmas-New Year), INR.

price_period.description: Price period/source, e.g. 'December peak rate'. When the requested period has no tariff it ends with 'not listed'.

price_status.description: listed means the returned amount is an explicit tariff for stay_month (or the legacy standard quote when no month was requested). unknown means no applicable monthly price is listed; tell the user the realtor will quote it (see price_note).

stay_month.description: Requested month, 1-12; null when no month was requested.

type.description: 1RK, Studio, 1BHK...4BHK, House, Bungalow, Room, Villa, Hotel.

url.description: Telegram mini-app link: photos, video and a chat with the realtor.

title: Search rentals in Goa
